scope: ReleaseAcceptance delivery-proof gate requires a current CanonCommit for the edition

evidence.test: does not accept a byte-valid delivery proof when its edition has no current CanonCommit
evidence.command: npm.cmd --prefix api run test -- src/releaseAcceptance.spec.ts src/editionManifest.spec.ts src/deliveryProof.spec.ts src/contractCanonAdoption.spec.ts --reporter=dot

boundary: A valid DeliveryProof is insufficient without the edition's current committed CanonCommit; migration, calibration, governed E2E, independent review, preflight, and byte checks remain separate gates.
